name: Access Profile Owner Approval Notification
description: Notify the owner of an Access Profile that it has been granted as a side effect of a Role request being approved.
subject: A user has been granted ${accessProfileName} through a role request
body:
Access Profile granted through a role request

Dear ${user.name},

${requesterName}'s request for the role ${requestedRoleName}#if($requesterName != $requestedForIdentityName) for ${requestedForIdentityName}#{end} has been approved.

${requestedForIdentityName} has been granted all Access Profiles contained in that role, including ${accessProfileName}.

#if($startDate)

${requestedForIdentityName}'s access to ${accessProfileName} is scheduled to start on ${startDate}.

#{end} #if($removeDate)

${requestedForIdentityName}'s access to ${accessProfileName} is scheduled to end on ${removeDate}.

#{end}

You are receiving this email because you are listed as the owner of ${accessProfileName}.

Thank you,
The ${PRODUCT_NAME} Team
